subject: general
question: In 2020, VP Dhananjayan and Shanta Dhananjayan were honoured with Sri Shanmukh ananda National Eminence Award in the field of ______.
solution:
The correct answer is **__Dance__.**

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Vannadil Pudiyaveettil Dhananjayan and Shanta Dhananjayan**, also known as the **Dhananjayans.**
 
• They are **a dancing couple of India** and were **awarded Padma Bhushan in 2009. **
 
• They were honored with** Sri Shanmukh ananda National Eminence Award** in the field of dance in 2020.
 
• They were honored with the **Sangeet Natak Academy Award, Government of India, 1994.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**__**National Eminence Award**__

 
• The National Eminence Award is granted only once during the lifetime of the awardee and he/she would be disqualified if he/she surrenders or is directed to surrender any national honors like Padmashri, Padma Bhushan, Padma Vibhushan, etc.
 
• The Award carries a cash prize of **Rs .2,50,000** a Citation, a gold-coated lamp, a trophy, and a shawl.
 
• **The National Eminence Award covers any of the following fields:**
 
 
• Music of all forms and origin
 
• Dance
 
• Theatre
 
• Fine Arts Administrators
